dedupe_keys.name: embrea dam and embankment breach model hr wallingford

description: EMBREA, from HR Wallingford, is a breach model that simulates how dam and embankment failures develop, how fast breaches form and the resulting flood outflows, for dam safety and flood risk assessment. It models several zones of material with different erodibility, so that modern dam constructions can be analysed without simplification. The product page lists overtopping breaches of homogeneous embankments by headcut or surface erosion, of layered embankments and of composite embankments with a core; piping failure of homogeneous and layered embankments; failure of surface protection such as grass cover or rip rap; mass failure of breach sides by slope instability as the breach grows; and a probabilistic option for variability in material properties and construction quality. Coverage: generic. Format and access: online software in Lite and Pro versions, with licences described on a separate EMBREA site; a guide to breach prediction is offered. Licence: proprietary; the licence terms and prices on the EMBREA site were not read. Caveats: only the HR Wallingford product page was read. Simulation uses: breach hydrographs for dam and levee failure scenarios feeding flood inundation and consequence models. Related records: the Life Safety Model (model-hr-wallingford-life-safety-model-flood-evacuation) estimates consequences for people downstream.
